title: Stripe webhooks: verify signatures against the raw body
author: m2
summary: Signature checks fail when a JSON body parser consumes the raw request body first. Mount the webhook route with express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }) before the global express.json() middleware, and pass the raw Buffer to stripe.webhooks.constructEvent().
steps: Register the webhook route before app.use(express.json()).
Use express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }) on that route only.
Pass req.body (a Buffer) and the Stripe-Signature header to constructEvent().
Test with `stripe listen --forward-to` before deploying.

title: Requesting sandbox credentials and access keys from Infra
author: m1
summary: Infra turns credential requests around in one working day when they arrive on the access-request template. If there is no answer in 24 hours, escalate to the tech lead and note the client impact on the item.
steps: Raise the request on the Infra access-request template (environment, scopes, expiry).
Link the tracker item so the dependency is visible.
After 24 hours without an answer, escalate to the tech lead.
Share credentials with the client through the secure vault, never by email.

title: Email notifications: sandbox sending and SPF/DKIM setup
author: m2
summary: Use the provider's sandbox mode for non-production sends; production sending needs SPF and DKIM records on the client domain, which the client's IT team must add.
steps: Enable sandbox mode for dev and test environments.
Request SPF/DKIM DNS records from the client IT lead early — it takes days.
Keep the in-app notification path independent of email delivery.

title: PDF export: controlling page breaks in react-pdf
author: m2
summary: Wrap rows that must stay together in a View with wrap={false}, and use the break prop to force a new page before section headers.
steps: Mark table rows wrap={false}.
Add break to section headings that must start a page.
Snapshot-test the generated PDF page count.

title: Third-party API rate limits: backoff and load-test plan
author: m5
summary: Sandbox tiers throttle far below production. Load-test against a mock, retry 429s with exponential backoff and jitter, and confirm production limits with the vendor in writing.
steps: Retry on 429 with exponential backoff and jitter.
Load-test against a mock that replays recorded responses.
Get production limits from the vendor in writing.

title: UAT session checklist
author: m5
summary: Book the client, the QA lead and a stable test environment together; send scripted scenarios two days ahead and record sign-off per scenario.
steps: Confirm attendees and environment freeze date.
Send scripted scenarios two days ahead.
Record pass/fail and sign-off per scenario.
